Ebola Outbreak in Congo Claims Over 930 Lives Amidst Spreading Crisis

The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has resulted in at least 930 deaths, with some reports indicating over 1,300 fatalities. Over 2,000 cases have been recorded. The World Health Organization has warned that the virus is spreading faster than in previous outbreaks. In a 24-hour period, 37 new deaths were reported, including dozens of health workers. Safety concerns have hampered response efforts, with over 12 attacks on response teams documented.
